request.text:
세상에 쉬운 일이 없다마는 자녀를 키우는 것은 할수록 어렵다.
내일 경기에 최선을 다해 보겠다마는 상대가 워낙 강해 자신은 없다.
도와주겠다는 마음은 고맙다마는 이번 일은 내 힘으로 해결하고 싶네.
혹시 시간이 있으면 내 과제를 좀 도와줄래?
내가 도움이 될지는 모르겠다마는 일단 도와줄게.
네 상황은 안타깝다만 내가 도와줄 수는 없다.
검사 결과 건강은 괜찮다만 피로가 쉽게 없어지지 않는다.
이 레스토랑은 맛이 좋기는 하다만 너무 비싸다.
뷔페에 왔는데 왜 그렇게 안 먹어?
먹을 것은 많다만 먹고 싶은 것은 별로 없어서.
네 소식은 가끔 듣는다마는 통 못 보니 보고 싶구나.
주는 거니까 받기는 받는다마는 다음부터는 선물을 가지고 오지 말거라.
남들은 내 차림을 보고 웃는다마는 난 남의 시선은 신경 쓰지 않는다.
어제 빌려준 책은 다 읽었니?
과제여서 읽기는 읽는다마는 정말 지루해서 아직 반도 못 읽었어.
책을 계속 읽는다만 밖이 시끄러워 내용이 잘 들어오지 않는다.
너는 항상 나에게 불평을 늘어놓는다만 그래도 달라지는 것은 없다.
부모님과 동생도 도와준다고 돕는다만 여전히 갓난아이를 보는 일은 무척 힘들었다.
웬일로 과자를 먹고 있어? 
먹을 게 없어서 먹는다만 역시 너무 달고 별로야.
눈이 많이 온다마는 그래도 운동하러 가야겠다.
잊어 보려고 애를 쓴다마는 어머니 생각에 나도 모르게 눈물이 난다.
항상 잠은 잘 잔다마는 나는 그래도 밤에는 커피 마시는 것을 자제한다.
내일은 병원에 꼭 가 보세요.
네가 가라고 해서 간다마는 크게 아프지도 않은데 썩 내키지 않는구나.
빌려 온 책이라 읽기는 한다만 재미는 없다.
비가 시원하게도 내린다만 내 마음은 답답하기만 하다.
다들 바쁘게 사는 줄은 안다만 내 결혼식에 꼭 와 주었으면 좋겠다.
이 김치찌개는 매울 것 같아.
빨개서 매워 보인다만 실제로는 먹을 만해.

rules.auxiliary: Separate a licensed connective plus attached auxiliary.
rules.auxiliary.internal_particle: Retain a licensed particle between an ending and the following auxiliary predicate.
rules.boundary.attached: Recover an ending consonant fused into the final syllable.
rules.boundary.consonant: Consonant-final stem selects the consonant allomorph.
rules.boundary.copular: License a 라-family ending after 이다 or 아니다, preserving the stem.
rules.boundary.eu: Select the (으) allomorph according to the stem boundary.
rules.boundary.regular: Remove an ending with no stem spelling change.
rules.contraction.deictic_verb: Recover dictionary-listed 그러/이러/저러 and 고러/요러/조러 vowel contractions, including past inflection; preserve the homonymous adjective and whole-word readings.
rules.contraction.ha_aspiration: Restore 하 whose ㅎ aspirates the following ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅈ after a vowel or sonorant base.
rules.contraction.negative: Expand contracted 잖/찮 into 지/하지 plus auxiliary 않다.
rules.contraction.vowel: Undo vowel contraction (와, 워, 돼, or 여).
rules.contraction.yeo_absorption: Recover 어 absorbed after an open ㅕ stem (켜, 펴); retain the separate ㅣ + 어 contraction reading.
rules.copula: Separate a nominal and the affirmative copula 이다.
rules.copula.adverbial_base: Retain a source-attested adverbial base before a copula, separately from any nominal homonym; the source inventory does not select its contextual sense.
rules.copula.omitted_ending: Restore omitted copular 이 after a vowel-final nominal before a reviewed ending; the nominal is not a conjugated verb stem.
rules.copula.omitted_honorific: Restore omitted copular 이 before honorific 시 after a vowel-final nominal; preserve the normal prefinal order and ending restrictions.
rules.copula.omitted_prefinal: Restore omitted copular 이 before modal 겠 or retrospective 더 after a vowel-final nominal, retaining prefinal order and ending restrictions.
rules.copula.polite: Restore the copula from 이에요/예요 or 이야/야.
rules.copula.zero: Restore the omitted copula after a vowel-final nominal.
rules.deletion.ha: Restore 하 deleted after a reviewed ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ-sounding coda before a licensed consonant ending.
rules.deletion.rieul: Restore ㄹ lost before a consonant ending.
rules.ending.causal: Recognize causal -기에/-길래 as an ending, distinct from nominalizing -기 plus particle 에; contextual reason and register are not selected.
rules.ending.declarative_contrast: Recover the source-owned -다마는/-다만 and present -(느)ㄴ다마는/-(느)ㄴ다만 connective bundles; retain final-ending plus particle alternatives without selecting a contextual sense.
rules.ending.direct_command: Separate modern command -거라 from a verb stem, or -너라 from an 오다-final stem. These are independent regular endings; lexical mood, register and intervening prefinals require separate review.
rules.ending.enumerative_yo: Recognize enumerative -요 after 이다/아니다, retaining vowel-final copula omission and the separate polite-particle reading.
rules.ending.exclamation: Recover distinct present, retrospective and copular exclamation bundles. 구려 also has a recommendation sense; morphology does not choose the contextual meaning.
rules.ending.friendly_command.n: Separate colloquial friendly-command -ㄴ from a bare 오다-final stem. KRDict 73877 illustrates adults addressing children or small animals; speaker, addressee, register, lexical sense and auxiliary attachment remain contextual hypotheses.
rules.ending.reporting_short: Recognize short reported statements, requests, proposals, questions and experiences; retain factual/command homonyms and surprise senses without inserting implicit 하다.
rules.ending.result_connective: Recover -아/어/여다(가) at a bare verb boundary, preserving the short and full forms and reviewed following auxiliaries; sentence-level transfer and object constraints are not inferred.
rules.ending.short_clause: Recognize a reviewed contracted quotation or change/conditional family as one component; preserve homonyms without adding an implicit reporting verb or choosing a contextual sense.
rules.identity: Unchanged vocabulary hypothesis; no dictionary verification.
rules.irregular.bieup: Hypothesize ㅂ irregular class: ㅂ becomes 우 (or restricted 오); ㄼ retains ㄹ before 우, as in 섧다 → 설워. Written entry forms determine lexical compatibility.
rules.irregular.digeut: Hypothesize ㄷ irregular class: ㄷ becomes ㄹ before a vowel.
rules.irregular.ha: Restore 하 from 해 or 하여.
rules.irregular.hieut: Hypothesize ㅎ irregular class: deletion or vowel contraction.
rules.irregular.reu: Restore 르 and undo doubled ㄹ before 아/어.
rules.irregular.siot: Hypothesize ㅅ irregular class: ㅅ disappears before a vowel.
rules.lexical.mal.complement: Retain lexical 말다 after a cessative or source-listed paired alternative complement; preserve both predicates and their own endings.
rules.nominal.colloquial_geot: Expand the colloquial 거/이거/그거/저거 nominal to 것/이것/그것/저것 before a copula; preserve the short lexical alternative.
rules.nominal.contraction: Restore contracted 거/것 plus a particle.
rules.nominalization: Analyze a nominalized predicate before a particle or copula.
rules.particle: Remove a particle with licensed order and boundary allomorph.
rules.particle.adverbial_focus: An adverbial base can take reviewed focus particles 도/은/는/만/까지/부터 and compatible outer particles. Preserve separate nominal and whole-word hypotheses; dictionary and context determine the lexical class.
rules.particle.concessive: Attach concessive 만/마는 after a licensed final ending; retain the distinct nominal 만 reading where applicable.
rules.particle.contraction.l: Expand attached ㄹ to object/emphatic 를 after an open syllable.
rules.particle.contraction.n: Expand attached ㄴ to topic/emphatic 는 after an open syllable.
rules.particle.distributive: Attach 들 marking plural subjects, distinct from nominal plural suffix -들.
rules.particle.enumerative_da: Attach enumerative 다/이다 to a nominal in an equal-footing list; the surrounding enumeration is not inferred from this token.
rules.particle.future_question: Separate a particle following the question noun clause -(으)ㄹ지, retaining its ending and inherited allomorph and immediate-owner checks. No unwritten nominalizer or following verb is restored; context and register remain unselected.
rules.particle.polite: Attach polite particle 요 after a nominal, adverbial, or licensed ending.
rules.particle.recipient: This recipient reading requires a contextually appropriate referent (typically a person or animate/personified entity); lexical and contextual eligibility are not inferred.
rules.prefinal.modal: Recover 겠 after honorific or past markers.
rules.prefinal.obligation: Recover the intention or necessity expression -아/어/여야겠- as one prefinal-position bundle, without inserting an implicit 하다.
rules.prefinal.past: Recover 았/었; at most two past markers are licensed.
rules.prefinal.polite: Recover polite (으)오/(으)옵 before its licensed following boundary, after honorific/past/modal markers; contextual politeness is not selected.
rules.pronoun: Restore a contracted pronoun with its particle.
rules.suffix.adverbial.i: Recover a scoped adjective base before adverb-forming -이; retain whole-word readings.
rules.suffix.honorific: Separate nominal honorific -님; preserve the whole-word alternative.
rules.suffix.plural: Separate nominal plural -들 before particles or a copula; retain the unsplit lexical alternative.

producer.text:
"""Check the actual Nix launcher, assets and full original-source API payloads."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/josh/projects/klem')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'))
from declarative_contrast_runtime import without_elapsed

output = Path('/tmp/klem-declarative-contrast-web-launcher.json')
assert not output.exists()
package = json.loads((ROOT/'docs/declarative-contrast-package-nix.json').read_text())
auxiliary = json.loads((ROOT/'docs/declarative-contrast-auxiliary-nix.json').read_text())
browser = json.loads((ROOT/'docs/declarative-contrast-packaged-browser.json').read_text())
assert package['state']==auxiliary['state']=='passed'
cli = next(p for p in package['outputs'] if p.endswith('-klem-0.1.0'))
assets = Path(next(p for p in package['outputs'] if p.endswith('-klem-web-assets-0.1.0')))/'share/klem-web'
launcher = Path(next(p for p in auxiliary['outputs'] if p.endswith('-klem-web')))/'bin/klem-web'
body = launcher.read_text()
assert f'exec {cli}/bin/klem-web --assets {assets} "$@"' in body
help_result = subprocess.run([str(launcher),'--help'],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,check=True)
assert b'Usage: klem-web' in help_result.stdout
url = 'http://127.0.0.1:49344'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=20) as response:
    html = response.read()
assert html==(assets/'index.html').read_bytes()
asset_checks = []
for path in re.findall(r'(?:src|href)="(/assets/[^"?#]+\.(?:js|css))"',html.decode()):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url+path,timeout=20) as response:
        raw = response.read()
    assert raw==(assets/path.lstrip('/')).read_bytes()
